map.由测量系统误差与公差求 %GRR 使用指南: %GRR from Measurement System Error and Tolerance User Guide
map.输入测量系统误差 GRR（重复性与再现性合成）和零件公差带宽度，计算 %GRR: Enter the measurement system error GRR (combined repeatability and reproducibility) and the part tolerance band width to compute %GRR = GRR / tolerance x 100%. Used to judge whether a measurement system is acceptable: usually <10% is excellent and >30% needs improvement.
map.输入测量系统误差 GRR 与公差带，求 %GRR。: Enter measurement system error GRR and the tolerance band to get %GRR.
map.判量具可接受: Judge whether the gauge is acceptable
map.：%GRR = GRR / 总变异 * 100%。例：GRR=0.004、总变异: : %GRR = GRR / total variation * 100%. Example: GRR = 0.004, total variation 0.02, %GRR = 20%.
map.：%GRR=1.8/12×100%=15.0%，落在 10%~30% 之间属临界: : %GRR = 1.8/12 x 100% = 15.0%, falling in the 10%-30% critical zone, usually considered acceptable but needing attention; if conditions allow, improve the gauge or the method.
map.由扩展不确定度求单侧 95% 保护带: One-sided 95% guard band from expanded uncertainty
map.由公差带与测量标准差求测量能力指数: Find the measurement capability index from tolerance band and measurement standard deviation
map.<10% 优，10-30% 视情况，>30% 不可接受。: <10% good, 10-30% depends on the case, >30% unacceptable.
map.%GRR 基于总变异，P/T 基于公差，两者并列评估。: %GRR is based on total variation, P/T on tolerance; the two are evaluated side by side.
